title.narrative: UNICEF supported the Government of India to strengthen the national multidimensional poverty framework so it better captures the realities of children. This work highlighted child poverty and informed a unified national agenda to improve child focused poverty measurement, enhance child sensitive registry systems, and promote more equitable social protection and investments in children. Through partnerships with the national policy commission, key think tanks, UN agencies, and strong state level engagement, systemic improvements were achieved. These advances increased the visibility of children within the national Multidimensional Poverty Index and strengthened interoperable civil registries, paving the way for integrated service delivery that leaves no child behind.
